trace: Current shared RoleRequirements carries six u8 rating fields: athletics, endurance, physiology, surgery, command and religion. CharacterCapabilities::meets compares all six when called directly.

The create_recruitment_role reducer rejects any of the six above five. The helper used by update_recruitment_role and save_recruitment_role checks only athletics and endurance, along with precision. Under valid authority, ownership and other reducer preconditions, a supplied physiology, surgery, command or religion value above five passes that helper and is assigned to a public role or saved-role record. This is a static path comparison; no reducer, transaction or database was run.

The ordinary web form exposes athletics and endurance as individual recommendations and explicitly supplies zero for the four other fields. The role detail view shows those same two; physiology, command and religion are separately presented as party aggregate checks. A join-request path copies stored requirements and sets the four fields to zero before calling meets. Thus these fields are ignored on that specific matching path; no claim is made that an ordinary UI currently imposes or displays them.

The native table and strategic-web projection retain all four fields, and the approved-action payload can carry RoleRequirements. Trace their full callers and policy before treating them as legacy, removing them, or asserting user-visible failure. The shared ContactPrecision type is finite and nonnegative, whereas recruitment precision admits a bounded half-step set; they are not automatically interchangeable.
repair_direction: Establish whether the four per-role fields have any intended supported consumer. If they are obsolete under the party-level policy, remove them through the complete clean schema/API and generated-client workflow; if they remain supported, enforce one common admission contract and make each supported consumer honor the intended semantics. Preserve separate party aggregate checks, current meaningful recommendation behavior and legitimate value domains. Do not add migration shims.
